cadence: Evaluate each Overture release; promote only an explicitly pinned, verified release
changedRecordDetection: stable place ID plus canonical normalized-record hash
invalidation: rebuild changed spatial shards and dependency/neighbor manifests
manifest: release, input hashes, tool hashes, row counts, shard hashes and sizes
rollback: retain prior immutable manifest and shards
staleDetection: alert when pinned release trails approved cadence; never silently follow latest
